'''W4-KL''' was an [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].

==Behind the scenes==
The W4-K2 Astromech Droid is a pet that was added to the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as part of Update 2.10 on [[September 9]], [[2014]]. It is purchasable through the in-game Cartel Market.
